title: refactor(react,components): one visibleWhen scope builder for SchemaRenderer and page:tabs (objectui#12992)
body:
Fixes #12992
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

- `@object-ui/react`: the module-private `configEvaluationScope` in `SchemaRenderer.tsx` is now the exported `buildNodeEvaluationScope(predicateScope, boundRecord, pageVariables)`, with a JSDoc that names its four roots. It stays in `SchemaRenderer.tsx`; the package entry already re-exports that module (`export * from './SchemaRenderer.js'`), so `index.ts` needed no line. The body of the function is unchanged; only the name, the `export`, and the JSDoc moved. `SchemaRenderer`'s memo and `evaluateConfigBagInScope` call it as before.
- `@object-ui/components` (`containers.tsx`, `PageTabsRenderer`):
  - the derived-badge gate evaluator (objectui#12987) now calls `buildNodeEvaluationScope(predicateScope, recordData, pageVariables)` instead of spelling the scope inline;
  - the item-level `visibleWhen` evaluator (`isItemVisible`) now composes the builder too: the row spread flat underneath, the builder's scope, then `record` / `data` set to the row on top. Each key gets the same value as before (see "Root measurement"). After this, `containers.tsx` spells `current_user` nowhere outside comments.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/react: minor` (new export), `@object-ui/components: patch`.

### Name

`buildNodeEvaluationScope`, not `buildVisibleWhenScope`. The same scope evaluates every expression `SchemaRenderer` evaluates on a node (`properties`, `content`, the `visibleWhen` chain), and `evaluateConfigBagInScope` uses it for action-container members. A `visibleWhen`-only name would understate what a root added there reaches.

## Root measurement (both spellings, at base `4dfdebdf5f`)

| root | `SchemaRenderer` (`configEvaluationScope`) | `page:tabs` badge gates (inline) |
|---|---|---|
| ambient spread | `...predicateScope` | `...predicateScope` |
| `current_user` | `predicateScope?.user` | `(predicateScope as any)?.user` |
| `record` | only for a non-array object row | only for a non-array object row (same test) |
| `page` | `pageVariables` | `pageVariables` |

The two match on every root, so nothing changed and nothing needed a fork. Their inputs come from the same hooks (`usePredicateScope`, `useRecordContext().data`, `usePageVariables`). One input difference already existed and is unchanged here: `SchemaRenderer` adds a node's API-bound `data` to `predicateScope` once the binding answers, and the badge passes the ambient scope (see Acceptance notes).

For the item-level scope, the old literal was `{ ...row, ...predicateScope, current_user, record: row, data: row, page }`. The new one is `{ ...row, ...buildNodeEvaluationScope(...), record: row, data: row }`. Every key ends with the same value: `current_user` and `page` are written after the ambient spread in both, and `record` / `data` are set to the row last in both, so an ambient `record` / `data` is still covered, and an absent row still gives `record: undefined`, as before.

## Note on the card's line address

The triage comment's `containers.tsx` line range points at the item-level `isItemVisible` scope. The card body describes the badge mirror from objectui#12987. The badge mirror is the one with the same roots as `SchemaRenderer`. The item-level scope has extra roots (flat row, `data`, unconditional `record`); those are kept unchanged and still written out at that site.

## Tests

- New pin `packages/react/src/__tests__/buildNodeEvaluationScope-12992.test.ts`: the builder is exported from the package entry and returns the four roots for a fixture. `record` is absent for `undefined` / `null` / string / number / array. An ambient `record` is kept when no row is bound, and a bound row overrides it. `current_user` and `page` are written over the ambient spread.
- New source pin `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-tabs-scope-builder-12992.test.ts` (reads `containers.tsx` through `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`): the file imports `buildNodeEvaluationScope` from `@object-ui/react`, calls it, and spells no `current_user`.
- New pins plus the objectui#12987 pins (`page-tabs-count-visible-when-12987.test.tsx`, unchanged): 3 files, 15 tests passed.
- Every test file under `packages/react` and `packages/components` that names `visibleWhen`, `page:tabs`, `configEvaluationScope`, `evaluateConfigBagInScope` or `useConfigBagEvaluator` (56 files, new pins included): 56 files, 643 tests passed, at `654022a9c3`. Later commits change only a test-file comment line and add the changeset.
- `packages/react/src/utils/configBag.pin.test.ts` (its allowlist names the `boundRecord` row test in `SchemaRenderer.tsx`, which stays in that file) plus the source pin: 2 files, 5 tests passed, at `0706ba39cd`.
- Type-check: closure build `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build` (8 projects, exit 0), then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check`, exit 0. With `--listFiles`, each package's `tsconfig.test.json` program includes its new test file (1 hit each).
- Ablation, one run. `ablation-replace` put the inline badge mirror back into `containers.tsx` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `7743264bea58` to `d2e3e857a674`). The source pin went red (`no longer spells current_user itself`; 1 failed, 9 passed across the source pin and the objectui#12987 pins), and the objectui#12987 pins stayed green. Restore: blob after restore `7743264bea58`, equal to the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

The root config enables no type-aware linting, so linting only these files cannot change the result for any file this change does not touch.

- Docs: `packages/react/README.md` does not list the new export. The README was outside this card's file surface. Who picks this up: no one yet.

This is a guess from reading the code; no public entry point was measured.
